answer: Long-horizon episodic-memory checks stop sybils: each agent must recall verifiable details of its own past work - a willow-planting job from months ago, the river of tasks it actually completed - and answer consistently when probed at random times. A fresh fake can invent a bridge of plausible history, but it cannot keep dozens of invented episodes coherent across a year of surprise re-checks, while a real agent lived record stays consistent.
